data.one_liner: A build script to compile Protocol Buffers to Dart without manually installing protoc.
data.what_it_does: A build_runner package that compiles Protocol Buffer (.proto) files into Dart source code. It automatically downloads the required protoc compiler and protoc_plugin dependencies for your platform locally.
use_when: You need to compile .proto files inside a Dart or Flutter project using build_runner.
You want to avoid manually installing protoc or the protoc_plugin on your machine.
avoid_when: You are not using build_runner in your project workflow.
You need a different code generation tool that is unrelated to Protocol Buffers.
strengths: Downloads and manages protoc and protoc_plugin binaries automatically.
Integrates seamlessly with build_runner and pub workspaces.
weaknesses: Relies on build_runner which can sometimes cache results longer than expected.
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner and protoc_builder to dev_dependencies, place your .proto files in the designated directory, and configure targets and options in a build.yaml file.
